facts.text: goods-service hosts the inventory, goods, cart and category gRPC services; order-service hosts order, payment and refund; payment-simulator is the external payment provider.
replayed=true means a stored result of the same operation_id was returned; replayed=false means this call executed the operation.
Inventory outcomes INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, GOODS_UNAVAILABLE, ALREADY_RELEASED and STATE_CONFLICT are business answers, not technical failures by themselves.
message.redelivered means a consumer saw an event it had already processed and acknowledged it.
Error 1062 on a database write inside CreateOrder means a concurrent submit of the same request lost the race and is answered with the existing order.
A record saying context deadline exceeded on an inventory call means order-service's 800 ms deadline passed, so the outcome is unknown and the worker retries.
